Type: white desk with shelf hutch
Use: homework, drawing, studying; children's room, bedroom, study
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: white painted steel legs, white laminated top and hutch
Colors: white
Shape: rectangular top on four square legs with side stretchers and height-adjustment slots, a low open hutch with a shelf and a top compartment set on the back half, simple and light
Feel: bright, tidy, simple, cheerful
Goes with: colorful chairs, light wood, pastel accents, white walls; Scandinavian children's rooms or study corners

product.name: PHL
product.description: Use FIXA hole saw set to make a hole in the desktop where it suits you best, for cable management or JYSSEN wireless charger. FIXA and JYSSEN sold separately. This desk is designed to grow with your child, thanks to the three different heights.
